svg.aria-label: Barbell back squat, Setup: Set the bar across your upper back and brace with your feet about shoulder-width apart.
svg.title: Barbell back squat, Setup: Set the bar across your upper back and brace with your feet about shoulder-width apart.

svg.aria-label: Barbell back squat, Lower: Bend your hips and knees, keeping your heels down and knees tracking with your toes.
svg.title: Barbell back squat, Lower: Bend your hips and knees, keeping your heels down and knees tracking with your toes.

svg.aria-label: Barbell back squat, Bottom: Reach a depth you can control with your heels planted and back steady.
svg.title: Barbell back squat, Bottom: Reach a depth you can control with your heels planted and back steady.

svg.aria-label: Barbell back squat, Rise: Push through your whole foot and stand back up.
svg.title: Barbell back squat, Rise: Push through your whole foot and stand back up.
